name: The Debtor's March (signature title anthem)
role: Front-door identity hook — plays on the title hero behind the 3D internet-economy world; the recurring 'sit down and play' moment. This is the one phase where the march is unambiguously heroic.
emotionalTarget: defiant, satirical, cinematic — bureaucratic menace with a grin; a hook a teenager can hum back after one listen
engine: src/audio/AudioEngine.ts (Tone.js synth — no samples), built from the data in src/audio/score.ts

loop.note: Transport never stops between screens; the lead sequence runs underneath at all times and is opened only by the `title` phase stem gain. No hard cut, no seam. The seam is glued musically as well as electrically: bar 16 rests on A4 and then restates 'A4 A4' on its last two 8ths as an anacrusis into bar 1's 'D4 D4', so the loop point sits inside a rhythmic gesture rather than between two of them. 108 BPM gives 24,500 samples per beat at 44.1kHz exactly (bar 98,000, cycle 1,568,000), so offline renders trim to bit-exact loop points.

leitmotif.cell: D4 D4 F4 - A4 ('da-da-DAH — DAH'): two pickup 8ths into a held note on beat 2, answered on beat 3
leitmotif.notesSource: The authoritative 128-slot rhythm (pitch or null per 8th) is LEAD_THEME in src/audio/score.ts. `notes` below is that line with the rests removed — the pitch contour only, for singing/checking. Do not schedule from it.
leitmotif.shape: The cell recurs in bars 1, 3, 5, 9 and 13 — the ear learns one gesture and then follows where it is transplanted. Bars 5-6 are the rubber-stamp figure G4-G4-G4 ('DENIED-DENIED-DENIED'). Bar 7 charges up the dominant (B4 is a Dorian 6th smuggled inside A major, so the climb reads as nerve rather than menace) and bar 8 peaks on C#5 over the A-major chord — the grin, the brand note. Bars 9-16 are the debtor's half: 'we're still here' (three A4s), the descent home, the F-triad climb, and a final cadence back through C#5 onto the dominant.

signatureColors.C#: raised leading tone at every cadence — the 'defiant grin'. It is why this reads as a march with somewhere to go rather than a modal drone on D.
signatureColors.F#: D-major / picardy brightening, RESERVED for wins (stampGood, the `good` reveal sting, the recapGood colour). Never appears in the tune itself.

countermelody.shape: One sustained tone per 2-bar segment, each a chord tone or colour of its segment. The cycle always ends on C#5, so whatever else is in the mix the last thing said before the loop turns over is the leading tone.

harmonyRoman: i - bVImaj7 - iv - V - i - III - bVII - V7 (2 bars each; ends UNRESOLVED on the dominant so the loop restart is the resolution)
leadVoice: Dual detuned oscillators — pulse (width 0.35) + square at +7 cents — into a light asymmetric drive (0.12) and a tempo-synced FeedbackDelay('8n', fb 0.2, wet 0.18), volume -12dB. The beating between two slightly-apart waves is what makes it read as something BLOWN; a single clean oscillator would sound like the old bell-pluck.
brassVoice: PolySynth(fatsawtooth x3, spread 24) through a lowpass FILTER ENVELOPE sweeping 380 -> 1600Hz in 50ms and falling back over 350ms, volume -13dB. That 'bwah' swell is the entire difference between 'ledger orchestra' and 'ambient wash'.
intensityLayers: None — `title` is absent from INTENSITY_RULES, so it is a single static arrangement (the title is not a gameplay morph) and simply uses its PRESETS row. Money-Brain `brainGlow` warms counter (+0.22) and brass (+0.08) for returning players.

cuePoints.reveal: accent('title') fires once on title mount as the 3D economy resolves: A4 -> C#5 -> D5 as three crisp 8ths at 180ms (brass-pluck, doubled one octave down) over a D2 membrane boom and a four-hit snare ruff. ~1.1s, and then silence — the title card gets a gesture, not a drone. It is literally the tune's own cadence, so the stinger and the theme are the same idea.
cuePoints.phraseStamps: Low stamp-thock on bars 1/5/9/13 (0s / 8.888889s / 17.777778s / 26.666667s), each preceded by the snare's 16th ruff — the 16-bar cycle gets an audible 4-bar pulse without any change of material.
cuePoints.carriageReturn: Bar 16 beat 4 (35.0s): a band-passed noise zip (1600 -> 5200Hz, 180ms) and a bell ding — the page finishing, right as the next one starts.

transitions.in: ColdOpen -> setPhase('title') crossfade (finishCold). In `intro` `tension` sits at 0.32 and `lead` at 0. Both resolve into `title`, where `tension` is 0 and `lead` is 0.7: the theme has not been earned during the cold open, and arrives when it has.
transitions.out: Leaving the title (Choose your run) -> AppShell sets phase 'menu' on the mode screen — clean stem-gain ramp. In `title` the `lead` is 0.7. In `menu` the `lead` is 0.21 and `keys` takes the foreground at 0.64. Same piece, heard from the filing room next door.
transitions.quantize: Phase changes are gain ramps over 0.9-1.5s and are bar-agnostic; only accents are quantized (to the next 8th, requested ACCENT_PREROLL_MS = 120ms early).

accessibility: Respects global mute (master gain ramp) and is silent until a user gesture starts the engine. Mute only ramps the master gain, so the Transport — and therefore the visual beat grid every cinematic derives from — keeps running for muted players and pacing is identical. Reduced-motion does not silence audio; the user's stored mute preference defaults on under prefers-reduced-motion/data.
originality: Original composition for LifePatch. No transcribed, sampled, or copied melodies, beats, riffs, drops or arrangements. Papers, Please and Undertale were mood and instrumentation references only — nothing from either was reproduced.
license: Original work, in-repo synth. No third-party samples or external sources.

qc.sampleExact: 44100 x 60 / 108 = 24,500 samples per beat exactly; bar = 98,000; 16-bar cycle = 1,568,000. Asserted by the offline renderer before it trusts a loop point.
qc.noClipping: music bus 1.25 into master 0.85; lead -17dB, brass -13dB; verify no >0dBFS sum at title with the `title` accent stacked on the full anthem mix
qc.accentCannotHang: accent('title') soundingSec 1.1 <= STINGER_MAX_SOUNDING_SEC (2.222s); brassPluck envelope (a .008 / d .3 / s .04 / r .4) inside STINGER_ENVELOPE_CAP. This is the regression test for the held-chord 'beeping' this replaced.
qc.phoneSpeakerCheck: required — the sine sub is inaudible on a phone, so the march bass (triangle+saw) has to carry the low end on its own
